explanation: Multiplying by x and separating gives (1/y-1)dy=2x dx. Integration yields ln|y|-y=x^2+C. At (1,1), -1=1+C, so C=-2, matching option e. This proves the requested formal level set only; the original IVP has no differentiable classical solution because its equation at (1,1) requires 0·y'(1)=2.
